name: Cherry Punch Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Dive into our fun fruit fusion series with one of our Hy-R 1-gram pre-rolls or the convenience of our new Hy-R 5-packs, avaiable in 8 tantalizing flavors. Each pre-roll is infused with liquid diamonds and mouthwatering fruit burst terpenes, ensuring a consistently smooth, potent experience. We use premium flower - never shake or trim. Hy-R pre-rolls are your key to a flavorful journey, embodying Goldkine's commitment to excellence and innovation in every puff. Fly higher with Hy-R's by Goldkine.
